title: Draft: Qt: Add Supporters tab to About dialog
description:
Added a new Supporters tab to the About dialog displaying sponsors
    and donors. Platinum/Gold sponsors show logos, Silver/Bronze are
    listed as text links. Sponsor data is loaded from a JSON resource
    file that is only present in release builds. Development builds
    show a placeholder message with links to sponsor/donate pages.

@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+/** @file
+ *
+ * Wireshark - Network traffic analyzer
+ * By Gerald Combs <gerald@wireshark.org>
+ * Copyright 1998 Gerald Combs
+ *
+ * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+ */
+
+#ifndef SUPPORTERS_WIDGET_H
+#define SUPPORTERS_WIDGET_H
+
+#include <config.h>
+
+#include <QWidget>
+#include <QJsonObject>
+#include <QJsonArray>
+#include <QLabel>
+#include <QVBoxLayout>
+#include <QGridLayout>
+#include <QScrollArea>
+#include <QEvent>
+
+/**
+ * @brief Widget displaying sponsors and donors for the About dialog.
+ *
+ * This widget shows:
+ * - Sponsors in tiers (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze)
+ *   - Platinum/Gold: displayed with logos and links
+ *   - Silver/Bronze: displayed as text names
+ * - Donors: displayed as a flowing text list
+ *
+ * In development builds, shows a placeholder message instead.
+ */
+class SupportersWidget : public QWidget
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+
+public:
+    /**
+     * @brief Sponsor tier levels
+     */
+    enum class SponsorTier {
+        Platinum,
+        Gold,
+        Silver,
+        Bronze
+    };
+    Q_ENUM(SponsorTier)
+
+    explicit SupportersWidget(QWidget *parent = nullptr);
+    ~SupportersWidget();
+
+protected:
+    bool eventFilter(QObject *obj, QEvent *event) override;
+
+private:
+    void setupUi();
+    void loadSupportersData();
+
+    // UI setup helpers
+    void setupDevelopmentView();
+    void setupReleaseView();
+    void createSponsorsSection(QVBoxLayout *layout);
+    void createDonorsSection(QVBoxLayout *layout);
+
+    // Sponsor display helpers
+    QWidget* createSponsorCard(const QJsonObject &sponsor, SponsorTier tier);
+    QWidget* createSponsorTierSection(const QString &tierName, const QJsonArray &sponsors, SponsorTier tier);
+    QWidget* createLogoTierSection(const QJsonArray &sponsors, SponsorTier tier);
+    QWidget* createTextTierSection(const QJsonArray &sponsors, SponsorTier tier);
+    QString tierToString(SponsorTier tier) const;
+    QString tierStyleClass(SponsorTier tier) const;
+
+    // Data
+    QJsonObject supportersData_;
+    bool isDevelopmentBuild_;
+
+    // Main layout components
+    QScrollArea *scrollArea_;
+    QWidget *contentWidget_;
+};
+
+#endif // SUPPORTERS_WIDGET_H
